g.text: Built a lightweight neural network inference engine from scratch in C++20 (no
external math libraries): tensors, layers, a custom model format, and a runtime whose
outputs match PyTorch. Optimized it for CPU with an AVX2 matrix-multiplication
kernel, a thread pool, and INT8 quantization, reaching 97.15% accuracy on MNIST, with
a command-line tool and a browser demo.
Built a Retrieval-Augmented Generation application that lets users chat with uploaded
PDF documents and receive context-aware answers with source citations. Supports
multi-document querying, comparison across files, and information synthesis using
Python, LangChain, and ChromaDB, covering document ingestion, vector storage, and
Developed and published a collection of Cisco Packet Tracer projects demonstrating
network design, configuration, and troubleshooting: VLANs, routing protocols (OSPF,
EIGRP, BGP), DHCP, NAT, wireless networks, branch network simulations, data
encryption, and cryptography. Focused on real-world scenarios and preparation for
Built an n8n automation workflow that generates a short daily English report on
practical uses of AI, exposes it through a JSON API, and emails it automatically
every day at 3 PM. Uses scheduled workflows, webhook-based API access, AI-generated
content, and email delivery, and is structured to extend to Telegram, Discord, or a
Built a modern dashboard UI using React, Vite, Material UI, and Nivo Charts,
including interactive tables, role-based team management views, task tracking pages,
FAQ panels, and visual analytics through bar, pie, and network charts. Designed with
reusable components and mock data so it can connect to real APIs later.
